title: Which resources move between resource groups, and which never do

videos.script: A move in Azure sounds like a lorry. Unplug the machine here, plug it in there. {{lorry}} That is not what happens. The machine stays in the same building, on the same disk, and keeps running. {{stays}} What changes is its name. The resource group or the subscription in its id is rewritten. {{id}} And every script, alert and file that held the old name now points at nothing. {{broken}} Not every type can move at all. Microsoft keeps a table of them, and you will read it with a short program. {{table}} A network moves. A firewall does not. A load balancer depends on which kind it is. {{verdicts}} Between subscriptions, a machine travels with everything it depends on, in one request. {{together}} And one operation looks like a move and is not one: handing a subscription to another tenant. It deletes every permission on the way. {{tenant}} By the end you can say, before you try, whether a move will work and what it will break. {{end}}
